narr: Another wet, unsettled day continued across much of NE FL and coastal SE GA as a surface front draped across north FL lifted slowly northward. Locally, near record high |deep layer moisture with PWAT values 2-2.5 inches were in place with weak steering flow. Waves of morning coastal rainfall expanded inland with diurnal heating.
ev: At 8 PM EDT, broadcast media shared a video showing Main St near 8th St was flooded. Floodwaters reached halfway up tires. About 3 to 4 inches of rain fell by this time. At 8:32 pm, emergency management reported that Jefferson Street and the UF Health parking lot was flooded. This is a known flood-prone site due to its proximity to Hogans Creek. About 3 to 4.5 inches of rain had fallen in this area. Videos were later shared showing floodwaters reached up to a woman's waist and above tires on an SUV. Floodwaters began entering homes along Moncrief Creek including along Leonard Cir E and Moncrief Rd. Floodwaters were deep enough that JFRD was unable to evacuate residents from a home along Leonard Cir E. Old St. Augustine Rd and Pritmore Rd were closed due to flooding. Widespread flooding with numerous cars stuck in floodwaters were reported across the San Marco, Downtown Jacksonville, Riverside, Ortega, Avondale, Hogan's Creek, Moncrief park, and Norwood areas.
